overview.title: Town by the water
overview.p1: Dakhla’s port and waterfront give a sense of ordinary town life away from the kite camps: fishing boats, evening walkers and simple cafés.
overview.p2: It is not a monumental harbour — come for atmosphere and a change of pace after lagoon days.
overview.p3: Use it as a quiet evening option when you stay in town rather than at a remote camp.

q1.question: How far is the port from the kite camps?
q1.answer: Town sits apart from the main lagoon camp strip. Plan transfer time if you stay on the water.

q2.question: Is the waterfront safe in the evening?
q2.answer: Stick to lit main areas and use usual town precautions.

q3.question: Where can I eat near the port?
q3.answer: Simple fish restaurants and local plates are the main options around the harbour.

q4.question: How long should I spend at the port?
q4.answer: One to two hours is enough for a walk and a meal stop.

q5.question: Worth it if I only stay at a lagoon camp?
q5.answer: Optional. Better if you already have an evening in town or a transfer through the centre.
